STATE HORTICULTURE MISSION — SOLAR COLD STORAGE & ON-FARM PACK-HOUSE GUIDELINES

Component                     Target Region / Category          Subsidy Rate & Capital Cap
Solar Cold Storage (10 MT)    Hilly and North-Eastern States    50% capital subsidy up to Rs. 15,00,000 per unit
Solar Cold Storage (10 MT)    Plains and Mainland States        35% capital subsidy up to Rs. 10,50,000 per unit
Reefer Van Transport (6 MT)   Registered FPOs and Cooperatives  40% capital subsidy up to Rs. 12,00,000 per vehicle

Section 2: On-Farm Pack-House & Maintenance Norms (Line-Wrapped Schedule)
Under the State Horticulture Mission, individual farmers constructing an on-farm
pack-house with a minimum floor area of 36 square metres receive a one-time capital sub-
sidy of Rs. 1, 20, 000 per pack-house unit, disbursed in 2 equal instal-
ments upon physical verification.

Solar cold storage units must maintain a minimum battery backup duration of 18 hours
per day and a storage capacity of 10 tonnes of perishable horticultural produce.

Eligible farmer cooperatives operating solar cold storage units receive an annual
operation and maintenance grant of Rs. 24,000 per year for 3 years. Private corporate
retail chains are excluded from the pack-house and solar cold storage subsidy.
